# ChromaDB 1.5.9 is the latest release and the four advisories below list no
# patched version as of 2026-11-10. Vellum uses only embedded PersistentClient and
# EphemeralClient instances; it does not expose Chroma's authenticated HTTP,
# tenant-authorization, remote-model, or trust_remote_code paths. Do not add a
# Chroma server or remote client while these exceptions remain active.
# Recheck these four exceptions by expiry or when Chroma usage changes.
